Physical Model: Diffusion Tensor Imaging (Cholesky parameterization):
- The network outputs 7 parameter maps: S0 (baseline signal intensity) + 6 Cholesky factor components (L11, L21, L22, L31, L32, L33).
- The diffusion tensor D is reconstructed as D = L L^T, where L is a lower-triangular matrix with strictly positive diagonal elements (L11, L22, L33 > 0). This guarantees D is symmetric positive definite by construction.
- Forward model: S = S0 * exp(-b * g^T * D * g), where g is the known diffusion encoding direction and b is the known diffusion weighting.

env:
  seed: 42
  device: cuda
  gpu_id: 7
  gpu_memory_limit_mib: 35000
  gpu_reserve_cache: true
  preload_gpu: true
data:
  data_dir: <DATA_DIR>
  val_split: 0.15
  batch_size: 24
  num_workers: 4
  pin_memory: true
  drop_last: false
  dataset: slicewise
  preprocess: normalize_b0_mean
  orientation: axial
  augment:
  - name: flip_x
    p: 0.2
  - name: flip_y
    p: 0.2
  - name: noise
    p: 0.1
    std_ratio: 0.006
model:
  name: spatial
  spatial:
    use_KAN: false
    use_VAE: false
    encoder:
      type: UNet
      hidden: 128
      num_layers: 4
      use_gn: true
      residual: true
      dilation: 1
      stride: 1
      attention:
        enabled: true
        reduction: 16
        kernel_size: 7
        use_channel_attn: true
        use_spatial_attn: true
    decoder:
      hidden: 448
      num_layers: 5
      neck: 128
      dropout: 0.015
training:
  epochs: 1000
  lr: 0.00018
  log_every: 1
  ckpt_every: 5
  grad_clip: 0.5
  optimizer:
    name: adamw
    adamw:
      weight_decay: 0.0001
  scheduler:
    name: warmup_plateau
    warmup_plateau:
      warmup_epochs: 25
      mode: min
      factor: 0.5
      patience: 28
      min_lr: 5.0e-07
      eta_min: 0.0
  early_stopping:
    enabled: true
    patience: 160
    min_delta: 5.0e-07

  data_consistency:
    shell_weighting: manual
    shell_weights:
    - 0.65
